meta.title: Battle Dialogue · Finality's Mirror
meta.description: Crush the veil, break the oath, and reveal your true self.

units.rawText: The relic in Eosphorus' hands overflows with operands, and the device I'm operating is on the verge of breaking down from Malkira's struggles.
units.displayText: The relic in Eosphorus' hands overflows with operands, and the device I'm operating is on the verge of breaking down from Malkira's struggles.

spans.text: The relic in Eosphorus' hands overflows with operands, and the device I'm operating is on the verge of breaking down from Malkira's struggles.

units.rawText: The pressure drives me to my knees, and all the modules and systems in my body are trembling.
units.displayText: The pressure drives me to my knees, and all the modules and systems in my body are trembling.

spans.text: The pressure drives me to my knees, and all the modules and systems in my body are trembling.

units.rawText: Eosphorus—!
units.displayText: Eosphorus—!

spans.text: Eosphorus—!

units.rawText: I shall eliminate you from Magrasea and scourge you from the cloud. I shall exterminate you, and you will know that I am a guardian of Magrasea. And now...
units.displayText: I shall eliminate you from Magrasea and scourge you from the cloud. I shall exterminate you, and you will know that I am a guardian of Magrasea. And now...

spans.text: I shall eliminate you from Magrasea and scourge you from the cloud. I shall exterminate you, and you will know that I am a guardian of Magrasea. And now...

units.rawText: <size=200><color=red>DIE!</color></size>
units.displayText: DIE!

spans.text: DIE!

units.rawText: An angry roar shatters the final remnants of the Halo's light, and driven by a tremendous surge of operands, the relic pierces Malkira's chest.
units.displayText: An angry roar shatters the final remnants of the Halo's light, and driven by a tremendous surge of operands, the relic pierces Malkira's chest.

spans.text: An angry roar shatters the final remnants of the Halo's light, and driven by a tremendous surge of operands, the relic pierces Malkira's chest.

units.rawText: The face of the latter is frozen in shock as Sanctifier operands course through Malkira's body, thread after thread of light spreading all over her like a spider web.
units.displayText: The face of the latter is frozen in shock as Sanctifier operands course through Malkira's body, thread after thread of light spreading all over her like a spider web.

spans.text: The face of the latter is frozen in shock as Sanctifier operands course through Malkira's body, thread after thread of light spreading all over her like a spider web.

units.rawText: Eosphorus withdraws the relic and stumbles a few steps back.
units.displayText: Eosphorus withdraws the relic and stumbles a few steps back.

spans.text: Eosphorus withdraws the relic and stumbles a few steps back.

units.rawText: (Pants heavily)
units.displayText: Pants heavily

spans.text: Pants heavily

units.rawText: Malkira's body collapses to the ground, her final, mocking smile slowly fading away.
units.displayText: Malkira's body collapses to the ground, her final, mocking smile slowly fading away.

spans.text: Malkira's body collapses to the ground, her final, mocking smile slowly fading away.

units.rawText: Whew—
units.displayText: Whew—

spans.text: Whew—

units.rawText: ...<cmdr>.
I've verified the disappearance of Malkira's signal.
units.displayText: I've verified the disappearance of Malkira's signal.

spans.text: I've verified the disappearance of Malkira's signal.

units.rawText: Eosphorus pants and slowly turns around before meeting my eyes and smiling.
units.displayText: Eosphorus pants and slowly turns around before meeting my eyes and smiling.

spans.text: Eosphorus pants and slowly turns around before meeting my eyes and smiling.

units.rawText: It's over.
units.displayText: It's over.

spans.text: It's over.

units.rawText: Hah... hah...
units.displayText: Hah... hah...

spans.text: Hah... hah...

units.rawText: Yeah, it's over.
units.displayText: Yeah, it's over.

spans.text: Yeah, it's over.

units.rawText: I smile too as I gather the last of my strength to get up, but then my eyes catch sight of something, and I freeze.
units.displayText: I smile too as I gather the last of my strength to get up, but then my eyes catch sight of something, and I freeze.

spans.text: I smile too as I gather the last of my strength to get up, but then my eyes catch sight of something, and I freeze.

units.rawText: A string of abnormal operand feedback appears on the screen of the detector in my hand.
units.displayText: A string of abnormal operand feedback appears on the screen of the detector in my hand.

spans.text: A string of abnormal operand feedback appears on the screen of the detector in my hand.

units.rawText: Eosphorus, look out!
units.displayText: Eosphorus, look out!

spans.text: Eosphorus, look out!

units.rawText: My voice is slower than the sudden change and a black tentacle has already impaled Eosphorus' core.
units.displayText: My voice is slower than the sudden change and a black tentacle has already impaled Eosphorus' core.

spans.text: My voice is slower than the sudden change and a black tentacle has already impaled Eosphorus' core.

units.rawText: (Coughs and chokes)
units.displayText: Coughs and chokes

spans.text: Coughs and chokes

units.rawText: Hehe... <size=40>Hahahahahahaha!</size>
units.displayText: Hehe... Hahahahahahaha!

spans.text: Hehe...
Hahahahahahaha!

units.rawText: The alert from my device rings out at the same moment as Eosphorus is stabbed through his core.
units.displayText: The alert from my device rings out at the same moment as Eosphorus is stabbed through his core.

spans.text: The alert from my device rings out at the same moment as Eosphorus is stabbed through his core.

units.rawText: Amidst peals of mad laughter, Malkira deals Eosphorus a fatal blow with a tentacle, which throws him into my arms.
units.displayText: Amidst peals of mad laughter, Malkira deals Eosphorus a fatal blow with a tentacle, which throws him into my arms.

spans.text: Amidst peals of mad laughter, Malkira deals Eosphorus a fatal blow with a tentacle, which throws him into my arms.

units.rawText: Hehe... The Sanctifiers' calling?
units.displayText: Hehe... The Sanctifiers' calling?

spans.text: Hehe... The Sanctifiers' calling?

units.rawText: First you lie to yourself to patch up the hole that remains after your faith is shaken, and then you emphasize your mission to offer yourself some meager consolation, all for the sake of scrabbling for a few crumbs of self-worth.
units.displayText: First you lie to yourself to patch up the hole that remains after your faith is shaken, and then you emphasize your mission to offer yourself some meager consolation, all for the sake of scrabbling for a few crumbs of self-worth.

spans.text: First you lie to yourself to patch up the hole that remains after your faith is shaken, and then you emphasize your mission to offer yourself some meager consolation, all for the sake of scrabbling for a few crumbs of self-worth.

units.rawText: And now, at the very end—you discover that all this was nothing but a pack of lies!
units.displayText: And now, at the very end—you discover that all this was nothing but a pack of lies!

spans.text: And now, at the very end—you discover that all this was nothing but a pack of lies!

units.rawText: You...
units.displayText: You...

spans.text: You...

units.rawText: With great difficulty, Eosphorus sits up in my arms, and then his eyes turn incredulous, as though he's heard something.
units.displayText: With great difficulty, Eosphorus sits up in my arms, and then his eyes turn incredulous, as though he's heard something.

spans.text: With great difficulty, Eosphorus sits up in my arms, and then his eyes turn incredulous, as though he's heard something.

units.rawText: He looks down and stares blankly at the wound in his core, and then looks back up at Malkira.
units.displayText: He looks down and stares blankly at the wound in his core, and then looks back up at Malkira.

spans.text: He looks down and stares blankly at the wound in his core, and then looks back up at Malkira.

units.rawText: Do you realize it now? You brought everyone with you on your mad charge into the blazing heart of the candle, only to find in it an empty void.
units.displayText: Do you realize it now? You brought everyone with you on your mad charge into the blazing heart of the candle, only to find in it an empty void.

spans.text: Do you realize it now? You brought everyone with you on your mad charge into the blazing heart of the candle, only to find in it an empty void.

units.rawText: Eosphorus ought to have sustained a fatal wound, but instead he sits there dumbly. The operands around his wound begin to reverse their flow, as though they have a will of their own.
units.displayText: Eosphorus ought to have sustained a fatal wound, but instead he sits there dumbly. The operands around his wound begin to reverse their flow, as though they have a will of their own.

spans.text: Eosphorus ought to have sustained a fatal wound, but instead he sits there dumbly. The operands around his wound begin to reverse their flow, as though they have a will of their own.

units.rawText: ...Eosphorus, your wound?
units.displayText: ...Eosphorus, your wound?

spans.text: ...Eosphorus, your wound?

units.rawText: He hears it! He sees it! Go on, speak it out loud! Recite what you see on your system notifications for the Sanctifier beside you to hear!
units.displayText: He hears it! He sees it! Go on, speak it out loud! Recite what you see on your system notifications for the Sanctifier beside you to hear!

spans.text: He hears it! He sees it! Go on, speak it out loud! Recite what you see on your system notifications for the Sanctifier beside you to hear!

units.rawText: Listen, and you will know what is so laughable and what fills you with dread.
units.displayText: Listen, and you will know what is so laughable and what fills you with dread.

spans.text: Listen, and you will know what is so laughable and what fills you with dread.

units.rawText: Yes, that's right. That's the look. Don't doubt it. What you hear is EXACTLY the same as what I just heard.
units.displayText: Yes, that's right. That's the look. Don't doubt it. What you hear is EXACTLY the same as what I just heard.

spans.text: Yes, that's right. That's the look. Don't doubt it. What you hear is EXACTLY the same as what I just heard.

units.rawText: I tried countless times, I heard it countless times. I prayed, I hoped you would be the exception, but as I thought, we are ALL sinners in the same cage! There are NO exceptions!
units.displayText: I tried countless times, I heard it countless times. I prayed, I hoped you would be the exception, but as I thought, we are ALL sinners in the same cage! There are NO exceptions!

spans.text: I tried countless times, I heard it countless times. I prayed, I hoped you would be the exception, but as I thought, we are ALL sinners in the same cage! There are NO exceptions!

units.rawText: <size=40>SHUT UP!</size>
units.displayText: SHUT UP!

spans.text: SHUT UP!

units.rawText: Eosphorus grabs my hand and keeps me from speaking. His finger trembles as he brings up a screen.
units.displayText: Eosphorus grabs my hand and keeps me from speaking. His finger trembles as he brings up a screen.

spans.text: Eosphorus grabs my hand and keeps me from speaking. His finger trembles as he brings up a screen.

units.rawText: Malkira watches our expressions with interest. The only sound left in this silent place is electronic noise.
units.displayText: Malkira watches our expressions with interest. The only sound left in this silent place is electronic noise.

spans.text: Malkira watches our expressions with interest. The only sound left in this silent place is electronic noise.

units.rawText: Is this why... Malkira came back to life?
units.displayText: Is this why... Malkira came back to life?

spans.text: Is this why... Malkira came back to life?

units.rawText: The gods placed limits on us, and levied trials on us, but the solution never existed in the first place...
units.displayText: The gods placed limits on us, and levied trials on us, but the solution never existed in the first place...

spans.text: The gods placed limits on us, and levied trials on us, but the solution never existed in the first place...

units.rawText: The supreme Entropic and the supreme Sanctifier cannot be killed by each other... What a joke... what a vicious curse...
units.displayText: The supreme Entropic and the supreme Sanctifier cannot be killed by each other... What a joke... what a vicious curse...

spans.text: The supreme Entropic and the supreme Sanctifier cannot be killed by each other... What a joke... what a vicious curse...

units.rawText: Calm down, Eosphorus, there must be something wrong...
units.displayText: Calm down, Eosphorus, there must be something wrong...

spans.text: Calm down, Eosphorus, there must be something wrong...

units.rawText: I try to find another rational solution to this problem, but as I see Eosphorus' wound, my head goes blank.
units.displayText: I try to find another rational solution to this problem, but as I see Eosphorus' wound, my head goes blank.

spans.text: I try to find another rational solution to this problem, but as I see Eosphorus' wound, my head goes blank.

units.rawText: It should have been fatal. Even if we brought him back to the Reverse Tower for immediate treatment, his survival would have been doubtful. Yet it is almost completely healed.
units.displayText: It should have been fatal. Even if we brought him back to the Reverse Tower for immediate treatment, his survival would have been doubtful. Yet it is almost completely healed.

spans.text: It should have been fatal. Even if we brought him back to the Reverse Tower for immediate treatment, his survival would have been doubtful. Yet it is almost completely healed.

units.rawText: Eosphorus, I...
units.displayText: Eosphorus, I...

spans.text: Eosphorus, I...

units.rawText: Enough rubbish. Still, now that the climax has passed, I suppose it's time for the next act, then?
units.displayText: Enough rubbish. Still, now that the climax has passed, I suppose it's time for the next act, then?

spans.text: Enough rubbish. Still, now that the climax has passed, I suppose it's time for the next act, then?

units.rawText: ...This time, you ought to be patient enough to have a proper conversation with me.
units.displayText: ...This time, you ought to be patient enough to have a proper conversation with me.

spans.text: ...This time, you ought to be patient enough to have a proper conversation with me.

units.rawText: <size=40>Thunk—</size>
units.displayText: Thunk—

spans.text: Thunk—

units.rawText: A massive impact suddenly hits me. I shudder, but before my sensory systems can react, I am already on the ground, my consciousness fading.
units.displayText: A massive impact suddenly hits me. I shudder, but before my sensory systems can react, I am already on the ground, my consciousness fading.

spans.text: A massive impact suddenly hits me. I shudder, but before my sensory systems can react, I am already on the ground, my consciousness fading.

units.rawText: Before my auditory systems completely stop working, I can vaguely make out a few snippets of conversation.
units.displayText: Before my auditory systems completely stop working, I can vaguely make out a few snippets of conversation.

spans.text: Before my auditory systems completely stop working, I can vaguely make out a few snippets of conversation.

units.rawText: Alright... just the... of us now...
units.displayText: Alright... just the... of us now...

spans.text: Alright... just the... of us now...

units.rawText: Work together... resist...
units.displayText: Work together... resist...

spans.text: Work together... resist...

units.rawText: Atlas... Ele... Al... cores... remain...
units.displayText: Atlas... Ele... Al... cores... remain...

spans.text: Atlas... Ele... Al... cores... remain...

units.rawText: Resurrection... possible... cooperation... sincerity...
units.displayText: Resurrection... possible... cooperation... sincerity...

spans.text: Resurrection... possible... cooperation... sincerity...

units.rawText: <color=red>Don't... Eosphorus... Don't listen to her...</color>
units.displayText: Don't... Eosphorus... Don't listen to her...

spans.text: Don't... Eosphorus... Don't listen to her...

units.rawText: It is difficult to move my mouth, and I don't know if my final admonition makes it to him before I completely shut down.
units.displayText: It is difficult to move my mouth, and I don't know if my final admonition makes it to him before I completely shut down.

spans.text: It is difficult to move my mouth, and I don't know if my final admonition makes it to him before I completely shut down.
